For Neko

Scroll the letter — the button stays here. (I’m considerate like that.)

Neko,

Somewhere between China and Pakistan, fate looked at the map and said: “let’s be chaotic.” And then it dropped us into the same chapter in the UK… and somehow we met at uni in Edinburgh and everything changed.

We’re different in all the best ways — different worlds, different childhoods, different ways of showing love — and still, we found a rhythm that feels like home. Not perfect. Not easy. But real.

“I love you as certain dark things are to be loved,
in secret, between the shadow and the soul.”
— Pablo Neruda

We’ve had days that feel like sunshine… and days that feel like Scottish weather: windy, dramatic, and suspiciously determined to ruin our plans. We’ve fought, we’ve misunderstood each other, we’ve been stubborn (you) and also stubborn (me). But somehow… we always come back. Always choose “us” again.

Because the happiness you give me outweighs the pain of our fights — and the peace of you next to me is worth every stormy night.

I love the way you make the world softer. I love your little reactions, your little “hmm”, your little “are you serious??” face. I love that you’ve seen me at my best and at my absolute clownest… and you still stayed.

Four years in the UK later, I’m still choosing you — not because it’s easy, but because it’s you. My favourite person. My safe place. My funniest problem. My softest home.

Love always,
HaHa 💌
